summary:
Implemented the window title setting; nothing was run, and all changes were verified by reading the diff only.

Changes:
- rich/segment.py: added SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 as the last ControlType member; added Tuple[ControlType, str] to the ControlCode union.
- rich/control.py: added the SET_WINDOW_TITLE formatter emitting ESC ] 0 ; title BEL, and the Control.title(title) classmethod, which passes a single two-item tuple.
- rich/console.py: added Console.set_window_title beside show_cursor. It checks only is_terminal, buffers Control.title(title) and returns True, or returns False with nothing written. Google-style docstring includes the restore caveat.
- rich/_windows_renderer.py: one new elif branch calling term.set_title(title) once per title control. Win32 wrapper unchanged.
- CHANGELOG.md: created an Added section above Fixed under Unreleased, with a bullet linking pull request 2200.
- Tests: test_set_window_title (tests/test_console.py), test_title (tests/test_control.py), test_control_set_window_title (tests/test_windows_renderer.py, Windows-only module).

Open point: set_window_title goes through control(), which also skips buffering when TERM=dumb. In that case the method returns True without writing. This matches show_cursor and the spec's terminal-check wording; it can be changed to return False if preferred.

No commits were made. All added lines are within 88 characters.
